//: Worked example for `vlmkit gates`. Copy to your repo root as vlmkit.gates.json. Docs: docs/cli-reference.md#gates-config

defaults.//: Gates every page gets unless it overrides `gates`. `extraGates` adds on top.
defaults.//suppressions: Default-scope suppressions apply to every page. Use sparingly — a repo-wide exemption is the hardest kind to revisit.

suppressions.reason: Every page carries the same sr-only skip link; the manifest lists it because legal reviews the wording.

pages.//: A glob expands to one entry per file; ids become `docs:routes/docs/a.html` so --only docs still selects the group.

suppressions.reason: Payment-method tiles are deliberately styled per provider (brand requirement), so button styles do not consolidate here.

suppressions.//: An integrity exemption. The reason inside --allow explains the pattern; the reason here explains the approval. Both are printed.
suppressions.flag: --allow "near-misalignment@.provider-badge;provider logos are optically centred, not edge-aligned"
suppressions.reason: Optical centring signed off with design; the 2px probe cannot express it.
